headline: THE DOLOMITES AT YOUR OWN PACE
dek: Six scenes worth planning a journey around
caption:
The Dolomites are made for taking your time. 🇮🇹

Think turquoise lakes, winding mountain passes, quiet valley villages and those huge rocky ridgelines you recognise instantly.

Rather than ticking off every viewpoint in one day, make it a proper escape: spend time around Val Gardena for Seceda and the passes, then give the eastern Dolomites their own days for Lake Braies and Tre Cime.

A car offers flexibility, but buses and lifts serve many popular areas. Some summer access and parking arrangements need booking, so check the current official information before you travel.

Which experience would you build a trip around? Save this for your future Italy itinerary. 🗺️

Photography: Finge Holden, Andrei R. Popescu, Alan Jiang, Pascal Debrunner & Luka Verč / Unsplash.
